<td class="pl " style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_BusinessCombinationDisclosureTextBlock', window );">Anadarko Acquisition and Other</a></td>
<td class="text">Anadarko Acquisition and Other<div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On May 9, 2019, Occidental and Anadarko Petroleum Corporation (Anadarko) entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the Merger Agreement), which provides that, upon the terms and subject to the conditions set forth therein, Baseball Merger Sub 1, Inc., an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Occidental (Merger Subsidiary), will merge with and into Anadarko (the merger), with Anadarko continuing as the surviving corporation and an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Occidental. If the merger is completed, Anadarko stockholders will receive, in exchange for each share of Anadarko common stock, (1) </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$59.00</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in cash and (2) </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>0.2934</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> of a share of Occidental common stock. The Anadarko Special Meeting of Stockholders is scheduled for August 8 and we expect to close the acquisition promptly thereafter. </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:left;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:inherit;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On April 30, 2019, Occidental entered into a Securities Purchase Agreement with Berkshire Hathaway (the Berkshire Hathaway investment), pursuant to which Occidental agreed that in the event Occidental enters into and consummates the proposed acquisition of Anadarko, Occidental will issue and sell to Berkshire Hathaway, and Berkshire Hathaway agreed to purchase from Occidental for an aggregate purchase price of </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$10 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in cash: (1) </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>100,000</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> shares of a new series of cumulative perpetual preferred stock of Occidental, having a face value of </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$100,000</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> per share (the Preferred Stock), and (2) a warrant (the Warrant) to purchase </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>80.0 million</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> shares of Occidental&#8217;s common stock at an exercise price of </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$62.50</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> per share. Dividends on the Preferred Stock will accrue on the face value at a rate per annum of </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>8%</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> but will be paid only when, as and if declared by Occidental&#8217;s Board of Directors out of legally available funds. At any time when such dividends have not been paid in full, the unpaid amounts will accrue dividends, compounded quarterly, at a rate per annum of </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>9%</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">. Following the payment in full of any accrued but unpaid dividends, the dividend rate will remain at </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>9%</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> per annum. The Warrant will be exercisable in whole or in part, until the first anniversary of the date on which no shares of Preferred Stock remain outstanding; however, if any stockholder </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">approval is required for the issuance of Occidental common stock upon exercise of the Warrant, then unless and until such required approvals have been received, Berkshire Hathaway will not be permitted to exercise the Warrant for shares of Occidental common stock. The Securities Purchase Agreement is subject to certain closing conditions in addition to the requirement that Occidental has consummated the proposed acquisition of Anadarko. See Occidental&#8217;s Current Report on Form 8-K filed May 3, 2019, for more information about the Securities Purchase Agreement.</span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On May 3, 2019, Occidental and TOTAL S.A. (Total) entered into a binding memorandum of understanding pursuant to which, contingent upon completion of the merger, Occidental agreed to sell to Total all of the assets, liabilities, businesses and operations of Anadarko in Algeria, Ghana, Mozambique and South Africa for </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$8.8 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in cash, on a cash-free, debt-free basis (the Total transaction). </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On May 9, 2019, Occidental entered into a second amended and restated debt commitment letter, pursuant to which certain financial institutions committed to provide, contingent upon completion of the merger, a </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>364</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">-day senior unsecured bridge loan facility (the bridge facility) in an aggregate principal amount of up to </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$21.8 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">. Such commitments were subsequently reduced by </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$8.8 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">, to </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$13.0 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">, upon Occidental&#8217;s entry into the term loan credit agreement described below. Commitments in respect of the bridge facility will be further reduced to the extent that Occidental obtains certain other financing or financing commitments or completes certain securities issuances or asset sales. </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On June 3, 2019, Occidental entered into an </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$8.8 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> term loan credit agreement (the term loan credit agreement) with Citibank, N.A., as agent, and certain other financial institutions party thereto, as lenders (the term loan lenders), pursuant to which the term loan lenders have committed to provide, contingent upon completion of the merger, (1) a </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>364</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">-day senior unsecured term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of up to </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$4.4 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> and (2) a two-year senior unsecured term loan facility in an aggregate principal amount of up to </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$4.4 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> (together, the term loan financing). </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">Each of the Berkshire Hathaway investment, the Total transaction and the term loan financing are subject to certain conditions, including, in each case, the completion of the merger.</span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On June 3, 2019, Occidental entered into an amendment to its existing </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$3.0 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> revolving credit facility pursuant to which, among other things, the commitments under the revolving credit facility will be increased by an additional </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$2.0 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">, to </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$5.0 billion</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">, contingent upon completion of the merger.</span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">There can be no assurance that the Total transaction, the Berkshire Hathaway investment, and the term loan financing described herein will be completed on the terms contemplated or proposed or at all. See </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;">Management&#8217;s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations</span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> - </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;">Liquidity and Capital Resources</span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in Part II Item 1A of this Form 10-Q for more information.</span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">In the three months ended June 30, 2019, Occidental expensed </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$107 million</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in fees in connection with merger-related transaction costs and debt financing fees. </span></div><div style="line-height:120%;text-align:justify;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">On July 31, 2019, Occidental and Ecopetrol entered into definitive agreements to form a joint venture to develop </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>97,000</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> net acres of Occidental&#8217;s Midland Basin properties in the Permian Basin.&#160;Ecopetrol will pay </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$750 million</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> in cash at closing and </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>$750 million</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"> of carried capital in exchange for a </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>49</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">-percent interest in the new venture.&#160; Occidental will own a </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>51</span></span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">-percent interest and operate the joint venture.&#160;During the carry period, Ecopetrol will pay </span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><span>75</span></span>-percent of Occidental&#8217;s share of capital expenditures. The joint venture allows Occidental to accelerate its development plans in the Midland Basin, where it currently has minimal activity.&#160;Occidental will retain production and cash flow from its existing operations in the Midland Basin. This transaction is expected to close in the fourth quarter of 2019.<span></span>

<td class="text">Occidental has made its disclosures in accordance with United States generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP) as they apply to interim reporting, and condensed or omitted, as permitted by the Securities and Exchange Commission&#8217;s (SEC) rules and regulations, certain information and disclosures normally included in consolidated financial statements and the notes.<span></span>

<tr class="re">
<td class="pl " style="border-bottom: 0px;" valign="top"><a class="a" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.showAR( this, 'defref_us-gaap_NewAccountingPronouncementsPolicyPolicyTextBlock', window );">Accounting and Disclosure Changes</a></td>
<td class="text">Accounting and Disclosure Changes<div style="line-height:120%;text-align:left;font-size:10pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;"><br/></span></div><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;">In January 2019, Occidental adopted the new lease standard Topic 842 - Leases (ASC 842). The new standard requires Occidental to recognize most leases, including operating leases, on the consolidated condensed balance sheet. The new rules require lessees to recognize a right-of-use asset (ROU) and lease liability for all leases with lease terms of more than 12 months. Occidental adopted the standard using the modified retrospective approach, including adopting several optional practical expedients. Occidental has developed and implemented an internal software solution to support the identification, documentation, tracking, accounting and supplemental reporting of leases under ASC 842. Continued enhancements to the software solution through 2019 are expected to ensure manual processes are streamlined while maintaining control functionality surrounding completeness in population and reporting. See Note 13,</span><span style="font-family:Arial;font-size:10pt;font-style:italic;"> Leases</span>.<span></span>

<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>Tabular disclosure of assets and liabilities, including [financial] instruments measured at fair value that are classified in stockholders' equity, if any, that are measured at fair value on a recurring basis. The disclosures contemplated herein include the fair value measurements at the reporting date by the level within the fair value hierarchy in which the fair value measurements in their entirety fall, segregating fair value measurements using quoted prices in active markets for identical assets (Level 1), significant other observable inputs (Level 2), and significant unobservable inputs (Level 3).</p></div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>Amount, excluding tax collected from customer, of revenue from satisfaction of performance obligation by transferring promised good or service to customer. Tax collected from customer is tax assessed by governmental authority that is both imposed on and concurrent with specific revenue-producing transaction, including, but not limited to, sales, use, value added and excise.</p></div>

<table border="0" cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" class="authRefData" style="display: none;" id="defref_us-gaap_NumberOfOperatingSegments">
<tr><td class="hide"><a style="color: white;" href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.hideAR();">X</a></td></tr>
<tr><td><div class="body" style="padding: 2px;">
<a href="javascript:void(0);" onclick="top.Show.toggleNext( this );">- Definition</a><div><p>Number of operating segments. An operating segment is a component of an enterprise: (a) that engages in business activities from which it may earn revenues and incur expenses (including revenues and expenses relating to transactions with other components of the same enterprise), (b) whose operating results are regularly reviewed by the enterprise's chief operating decision maker to make decisions about resources to be allocated to the segment and assess its performance, and (c) for which discrete financial information is available. An operating segment may engage in business activities for which it has yet to earn revenues, for example, start-up operations may be operating segments before earning revenues.</p></div>
